updates.band.label: Your version
updates.goBack.fine: Later changes move to backups/before-restore-. From the command line: docker exec /holyarrs restore --pre-update, then docker restart .
updates.goBack.intro: HolyArrs kept a copy of its data from just before the update to {version} ({when}). To go back:
updates.goBack.step1b: If you pull from another registry, keep its name and change only the tag to {tag}.
updates.goBack.step2: Start the container again with that image (with Compose: docker compose up -d).
updates.goBack.step3: {version} sees that its data is newer and shows a page instead. There, type the one-time code from docker logs and press Put back the data from before the update. HolyArrs then starts on that data.
updates.goBack.title: Go back to {version}
updates.privacy: On each check HolyArrs asks api.github.com for the newest release, sending only the header User-Agent: HolyArrs/{version}. No account, no list of your media, no other data.
updates.releases.title: What's new
updates.said.behind: A newer release is out. Updating keeps your data and settings: they live in the config folder, not in the program.
updates.said.none: No HolyArrs release is published yet.
updates.said.problem: The last check did not work.
